description_full:
✨ Call for Internship ✨

The ERIA School of Government is pleased to announce that applications for the Internship Programme (Batch 7) are now open.

This programme offers a valuable opportunity to gain hands-on experience in public policy, research, and governance within the ASEAN and East Asia context.

📅 Duration: January – June 2027 (6 months)

We are seeking motivated, creative, and dedicated individuals who are eager to learn and contribute.

⏰ Application Deadline: 15 November 2026

👉 Swipe to see the requirements and responsibilities!

📌 Scan the QR code for more information!

🔗 Explore for more information: https://www.eria.org/about-us/career-opportunities
